notes: Fixes the real reason updates weren't sticking, adds a startup splash and a proper single-instance lock, gives chess a real engine and real difficulty, and fixes a memory-correction bug plus renaming safety.

changelog.headline: What's new in 1.0.9

sections.title: Updates
items: Found and fixed the real reason updates weren't sticking: the update process was failing completely on every attempt, silently, while still relaunching the app so it looked like it worked.

sections.title: Startup
items: The app now shows something on screen the instant you click it, instead of a stretch of silence while everything loads.
Clicking the icon again while it's already open just brings the running app forward instead of opening a second copy.

sections.title: Chess
items: The chess engine wasn't actually shipping, so the difficulty slider did nothing. There's a real engine now.
Fixed her mixing up which pieces are whose mid-game.

sections.title: Memory
items: Correcting a fact she got wrong could erase it entirely instead of fixing it. Corrections now keep the fact, just corrected.

sections.title: Naming
items: Renaming her now asks first and waits for confirmation, instead of acting on the first thing that sounds like a new name.

sections.title: Look and feel
items: Fixed the desktop icon and the in-app browser icon to show ELLA Zero's actual mark.

changelog.data_safety: Your chats, memory, notes, portfolio and settings stay exactly as they are. This update only replaces the app's own program files. Nothing you have created is touched or deleted.
